title: Residential Segregation and Unequal Access to Local Public Services in India: Evidence from 1.5 Million Neighborhoods
title_zh: 印度居住隔离与地方公共服务获取不平等：来自150万邻里的证据
authors: Asher, Sam, Jha, Kritarth, Novosad, Paul, Adukia, Anjali, Tan, Brandon
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We study residential segregation and access to public services across 1.5 million urban and rural neighborhoods in India. Muslim and Scheduled Caste segregation in India is high by global standards, and only slightly lower than Black-White segregation in the United States. Within cities, public facilities and infrastructure are systematically less available in Muslim and Scheduled Caste neighborhoods. Nearly all regressive allocation is across neighborhoods within cities—at the most informal and least studied form of government. These inequalities are not visible in the aggregate data typically used for research and policy.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了印度150万个城乡社区中的居住隔离与公共服务获取情况。按全球标准衡量，印度穆斯林与表列种姓的居住隔离程度较高，仅略低于美国的黑白种族隔离。在城市内部，穆斯林与表列种姓社区的公共设施和基础设施系统性匮乏。几乎所有倒退性资源分配都发生在城市内部的社区之间——这属于最非正式且研究最少的政府层级。这些不平等现象在通常用于研究与政策制定的汇总数据中无法显现。

title: Global Pension Asset Allocations and Debt Markets
title_zh: 全球养老金资产配置与债务市场
authors: Karen K. Lewis, Xiang FANG, Bryan Hardy, Karen K. Lewis; Xiang FANG; Bryan Hardy
official: 官方在线 2026-07-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The pension sector is an important investor group in global financial markets and a key holder of government and corporate debt. This article examines the evolution of pension fund asset allocations around the globe and documents two important structural changes. First, pension investors have shifted portfolio share allocations away from fixed income securities. This trend is robust across Defined Contribution (DC) and Defined Benefit (DB) programs as well as country groups. Second, pensions have instead shifted allocations into riskier investments within mutual funds as well as alternative investments. We hypothesize that a global decline in interest rates is one potential driver of this change. Using a global sample, we show that declining local currency government bond yields are associated with lower bond pension portfolio shares and higher holdings shares of mutual funds and foreign assets. We discuss the potential implications of these trends for borrowing costs. The declining holding share of pensions as a long-term investor group implies financing costs are less sensitive to new debt issues, but more sensitive to global uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 养老金部门是全球金融市场中的重要投资者群体，也是政府和公司债务的主要持有者。本文研究了全球范围内养老基金资产配置的演变，并记录了两个重要的结构性变化。首先，养老金投资者已将投资组合份额从固定收益证券中转移出来。这一趋势在固定缴款（DC）和固定收益（DB）计划以及不同国家组中均表现稳健。其次，养老金转而将资金配置到共同基金中风险更高的投资以及另类投资中。我们假设全球利率下降是这一变化的潜在驱动因素之一。利用全球样本，我们表明本币政府债券收益率的下降与养老金投资组合中债券份额的降低以及共同基金和外国资产持有份额的增加相关。我们讨论了这些趋势对借贷成本的潜在影响。作为长期投资者群体，养老金持有份额的下降意味着融资成本对新债务发行的敏感度降低，但对全球不确定性的敏感度增加。

title: Refineries, Pipelines and Petroleum Fields - The Impact of Oil on Conflict Around the World
title_zh: DP21648 炼油厂、管道与油田——石油对全球冲突的影响
authors: Axel Dreher, Maximilian Herrmann, Jingke Pan, Axel Dreher; Maximilian Herrmann; Jingke Pan
official: 官方在线 2026-06-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how global oil price shocks affect the spatial distribution of violent conflict. Combining monthly georeferenced data on oil infrastructure with conflict events worldwide over 1989-2021, we exploit exogenous variation in world crude oil prices within countries using grid-cell and country*month fixed effects. Oil price increases raise organized conflict in oil-bearing cells but reduce it in nearby non-oil areas, indicating a spatial reallocation of territorial violence toward economically valuable locations rather than a uniform increase in conflict. By contrast, lower-intensity unrest spreads across neighboring cells, consistent with diffuse grievance and mobilization channels. The effect is strongest for petroleum fields and driven by state-based conflict, consistent with intensified contestation over oil rents, while downstream infrastructure is associated with protests and localized violence. The magnitude of the response varies with ethnic exclusion, institutions, geography, and ownership, pointing to rent-contestation mechanisms shaped by local conditions.
abstract_zh: 本文研究全球油价冲击如何影响暴力冲突的空间分布。结合1989-2021年间全球石油基础设施的月度地理参考数据与冲突事件，我们利用国家内网格单元和国家*月份的固定效应，捕捉世界原油价格的外生变化。油价上涨会加剧含油网格中的有组织冲突，但减少附近非油区域的冲突，表明领土暴力向经济价值更高的地点发生空间再分配，而非冲突的普遍增加。相比之下，强度较低的骚乱会扩散至邻近网格单元，这与广泛的怨恨情绪和动员渠道机制一致。该效应在油田区域最为显著，且主要由国家间冲突驱动，符合围绕石油租金的争夺加剧现象；而下游基础设施则与抗议和局部暴力相关。响应强度因族群排斥、制度、地理和所有权而异，表明租金争夺机制受地方条件塑造。

title: Policy Catering or Market Choice: Industrial Policy Consistency and Firm Exports
title_zh: 政策迎合还是市场选择：产业政策一致性与企业出口
authors: Yuping Deng, Jinxiao Yang, Cenjie Liu, Rui Xie
abstract: ABSTRACT During China's transformation from a quantity‐oriented to a quality‐oriented trading nation, industrial policy consistency (IPC) between central and local governments has been an important driving force for firm exports. We investigate this IPC by extracting information on the preferential industries mentioned in the Chinese 10th to 12th Five‐Year Plans (FYPs) and empirically analyze the relationship between IPC and firm exports on the basis of Chinese firm‐level data from 2001 to 2015. The results indicate that IPC expands the firms' export scales but reduces the quality of products exported. This phenomenon is driven primarily by increasing subsidy reliance, intensifying excessive market competition and weakening innovation incentives. The heterogeneity analysis indicates that IPC has a more profound effect on the export outcomes of state‐owned enterprises, large firms, pillar industries and regions facing high levels of official promotion pressure. We further find that comparative advantages can relatively mitigate the decline in quality caused by policy consistency. Our findings have important policy implications for coordinating regional industrial policies and improving export competitiveness.
abstract_zh: 在中国从数量导向型贸易大国向质量导向型贸易大国转型过程中，中央与地方政府间的产业政策一致性（IPC）已成为推动企业出口的重要驱动力。本文通过提取中国第十至第十二个五年规划中提及的优先发展产业信息，基于2001-2015年中国企业层面数据，实证分析了产业政策一致性与企业出口之间的关系。研究结果表明，产业政策一致性扩大了企业出口规模，但降低了出口产品质量。这一现象主要源于补贴依赖度上升、过度市场竞争加剧以及创新激励弱化。异质性分析显示，产业政策一致性对国有企业、大型企业、支柱产业以及面临较高官员晋升压力地区的出口表现影响更为显著。进一步研究发现，比较优势能够相对缓解政策一致性导致的质量下降。本研究对协调区域产业政策、提升出口竞争力具有重要政策启示。
